tools.name: open_friday_flight_deals
tools.description: Open Friday Flight Deals to browse the latest cheap flight deals.

tools.name: get_latest_deals
tools.description: List the latest cheap flight deals from the Friday Flight Deals newsletter (title, url, date, summary).

labels.name: score_flight_deal
labels.description: Rate a flight price from 0 to 100 against the typical fare for that route and cabin. Use when someone asks if a fare is a good deal.

labels.name: check_hidden_city_ticket
labels.description: Assess the risk of hidden-city ticketing: buying a ticket to a farther airport and getting off at the layover. Returns the saving, a verdict, deal-breakers, risks and the airline's policy.

labels.name: find_route_fares
labels.description: Show the cheapest recent fares we track for an airport pair, by cabin, with the usual price and discount. Use when someone asks what a route costs right now.

labels.name: get_premium_cabin_guide
labels.description: Typical price, airlines, lounges and booking tips for business or first class to a destination such as japan, dubai, london, europe or hawaii.

labels.name: get_booking_tips
labels.description: Answer when to book, which day is cheapest to fly and how far ahead to buy, with data-backed tips. Optionally filter by topic keywords.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "open_friday_flight_deals" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Open Friday Flight Deals to browse the latest cheap flight deals." → after: "Open the Friday Flight Deals app, which shows the latest cheap flight deals. If you call this, do not also call get_latest_deals."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
